EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Good morning!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Man, this rain is
really making me snacky,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Buenos días!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Oye, esta lluvia
me está dando ganas de beber
{{TAG:0005:000E:0000}}, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bonjour !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Mince, toute cette pluie
commence à me donner soif,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Buongiorno!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Caspitina, questa
pioggia mi fa venire un certo
languorino, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Günaydın!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Bu yağmur beni fena hâlde
atıştırmalık moduna soktu, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Dark and stormy nights always
make me feel like something
exciting is about to happen!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}¡Las noches de tormenta siempre
me hacen sentir que está a punto
de pasar algo muy molón!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}J'adore les nuits de pluie !
C'est presque surnaturel.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Nelle notti buie e tempestose, ho
sempre la sensazione che stia per
succedere qualcosa di emozionante!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Karanlık, fırtınalı gecelerde içime hep
heyecanlı bir şey olacakmış
gibi doğuyor!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Rain's not so bad.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Don't I sound
super brave when I say stuff
like that,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Bah, la pluie, moi, ça ne me fait pas
peur.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} J'suis courageux, tu trouves
pas,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} ?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Yağmur o kadar da kötü değil.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Böyle
deyince bayağı cesur biri
gibi konuşuyorum, değil mi,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?

ES:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}¿No crees que ir por ahí tan
tranquilo bajo la lluvia me hace
parecer más guay,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Dici che quando cammino sotto
la pioggia anch'io ho l'aria da bello
e tenebroso,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Yağmurda dolanmak beni daha havalı
gösteriyor mu sence,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}A huh huh huh!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} It's like someone
launched a giant water balloon at
{{TAG:0005:0005:}}, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}¡Je, je!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Es como si alguien hubiera
lanzado un globo de agua gigante
contra {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}}, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Youpi ! Hé hé !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} C'est comme si on
nous avait lancé une gigantesque
bombe à eau, {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Äh, he he he!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Wenn man jetzt von
einer Wasserbombe getroffen wird,
macht das gar nichts,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Ahuhuhu!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Sanki biri {{TAG:0005:0005:}} kasabasına
dev bir su balonu fırlatmış, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}I totally want to splash you.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} You're
cool with that, right, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}On fait la danse de la pluie pour
qu'il pleuve encore plus,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}} ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} D'accord ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Posso schizzarti con l'acqua?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Dai,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}, sarà divertente!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Sana su sıçratasım var.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Sorun etmezsin,
değil mi, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Hola, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}{{TAG:0007:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Caminar bajo la lluvia es en cierta
forma como un deporte extremo...
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Porque si me resbalo en un charco,
¡zas! Al suelo. Es como una práctica
de riesgo, ¿no,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?

{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Caminar bajo la lluvia me ahorra
lo de poner la lavadora. Es la tira
de oportuno,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}L'avantage de marcher sous la pluie,
c'est qu'après, on n'a plus besoin de
laver ses vêtements,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Camminare sotto la pioggia è
un buon modo per risparmiare sul
bucato,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Der Regen wäscht gerade meine
Klamotten.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Das finde ich total
praktisch,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Yağmurda yürüyünce çamaşır yıkama işi
de aradan çıkıyor.
Ne kadar pratik,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0019:}}Uaaaah...{{TAG:0007:0000:3C000000}} Como estaba mirando
fijamente la lluvia,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} casi me quedo
dormido,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

{{TAG:0003:000D:}}¿Y qué pasaría si no dejase
de llover nunca,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Et s'il ne s'arrêtait plus jamais de
pleuvoir,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Caspitina! E se non smettesse mai
più di piovere,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Do you think all this rain'll make the
{{TAG:0005:001A:00CD}} trees in town grow
super tall?{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0004:}}I hope so,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si fuera {{TAG:000E:0002:}}{{TAG:0005:001A:00CD}} de los
árboles del pueblo, ¡me encantaría
esta lluvia,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sai qual è il mio frutto preferito?
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:000E:0001:}}{{TAG:0005:001A:00CD}}!
{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Ne mangerei a quintali!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Speriamo crescano tanti alberi da
frutto con tutta questa pioggia,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sence bu kadar yağmur kasabadaki
{{TAG:0005:001A:00CD}} ağaçlarını acayip uzatır
mı?{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0004:}}Umarım uzatır,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}« Il pleut, il mouille, c'est la fête à
la grenouille... » {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}La pioggia è troppo da urlo!
Ecco perché ballo, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Yağmurlu günler en sevdiğim günler. Pek
tatlı oluyorlar,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}I'll take rain over sun any day of
the week,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Si me dejaran elegir, ¡yo prefiero
siempre que llueva a que
haga sol,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Se dipendesse da me, farei piovere
365 giorni l'anno, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Haftanın her günü güneş yerine yağmuru
seçerim,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
